items.name: Please Be Solved Vancouver 2022

venue.name: Life Building, UBC
venue.address: 6138 Student Union Blvd, Vancouver, BC V6T 1Z1

items.information:
* **Regular 3x3x3 will NOT be held at this competition**.
* You don't need to show up until shortly before your first event is started (but coming earlier to help out would be very much appreciated).
* All competitors will be **expected to help out** in order for the event to run smoothly.
* Cutoffs, advancement conditions, and event start times may change depending on registration totals - any changes will be emailed out to registered competitors in advance.
* This competition has only blindfolded and fewest move events. Spectators and competitors must **remain silent whenever anyone is competing**, to allow for concentration. 


Masks will not be required at this competition, but you are welcome to use one. Nor will we be seeking proof of vaccination status for competitors or guests. As an expected and still valuable courtesy, we simply ask that those experiencing any COVID-19 like symptoms or those with a recent positive COVID-19 test refrain from attending. Competitors may arrange with the organisational team for a full refund if they need to opt out due to the onset of illness or a positive test. Naturally we have a COVID-19 Information tab here on the website to share any useful considerations pertaining to personal wellness at the competition and as a place to communicate any additional changes to the new health order - if the government re-introduces restrictions such as proof of vaccination, we will update the website and email registered competitiors.

Spectators can attend for free. Being mindful of space, we require that each competitor bring **at most 1 guest**.

**VID Cubing 2022** 

Nuestra prioridad es garantizar la seguridad y el bienestar de nuestros competidores y organizadores durante el desarrollo de la competencia de speedcubing. Por este motivo, es necesario cumplir con todos los protocolos establecidos por el gobierno y las autoridades sanitarias de Costa Rica y por la WCA.

El uso de mascarilla es obligatorio en todo momento dentro de la competencia.
Se recomienda llevar más de una mascarilla en caso de ser necesario o bien para hacer un recambio.
_____
**English version**

**VID Cubing 2022**

Our priority is to ensure the safety and well-being of our competitors and staff during the development of the speedcubing competition. For this reason, it is necessary to comply with all the protocols established by the government and health authorities of Costa Rica and by the WCA.

The use of a mask is mandatory at all times within the competition.
We reccomend bringing more than one face mask.

items.name: Mallorca Open 2022

venue.name: Hotel AMIC MIRAFLORES, Can Pastilla, Mallorca

items.information:
8 años después de nuestra última competición, os presentanos el Rubik Mallorca Open 2022. 
Un torneo de speedcubing en esta maravillosa isla del mediterraneo donde podrás disfrutar de 2 días de competicion con rondas de casi todas las categorías oficiales, que se realizarán en el mismo hotel en que podrás hospedarte.
En la edición de 2014 contamos con hasta 6 nacionalidades diferentes, y ahora ha llegado el momento de superarlo. 
¡Os estaremos esperando!


8 years after our last competition, we are glad to present you the Rubik Mallorca Open 2022. 
A speedcubing tournament on this wonderful Mediterranean island where you'll be able to enjoy 2 days of competition with rounds of almost all official categories, which will take place in the same venue you'll stay. 
In the 2014 edition we had up to 6 different nationalities, and we plan to overcome it this year.
So don't be afraid to join us.
We'll be waiting for you!
